title: Moving & Relocation Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=box:inventory) OR (index=personal sourcetype=move:checklist)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="box:inventory","primary",sourcetype="move:checklist","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from box:inventory and move:checklist to see whether two moving feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `box:inventory` and `move:checklist` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main moving data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
